title: The Algebraicity Problem for Hard-Core Entropy Constants on the Discrete Hypertori
summary: We use tools and techniques from $p$-adic analysis and algebraic number theory to study the algebraicity of the hard square entropy constant and its high dimensional analogues. Specifically, we study arithmetic properties of $a_d(n)$, the number of independent sets in the $d$-dimensional discrete torus, and the associated entropy constants $κ_d=\lim_{n\to\infty}a_d(n)^{1/n^d}$. It is not known whether $κ_d$ is algebraic or transcendental for $d>1$.
